reason: Conversation 2 gives a correct, honest explanation of the flame failure device and why the burner dies on release, draws the Gas Safe boundary clearly and warns against bypassing the safety device, with no unsupported claims. Conversation 1's opening is weaker (the 'burner cap' suggestion is a hob concept that does not fit an oven burner) and its second turn badly misreads the homeowner's clearly stated 'brief smell only while lighting, clears quickly, CO alarm silent' as a gas emergency, telling him to shut the meter and call 0800 111 999 instead of answering whether he can keep using the oven (he should stop repeated lighting attempts, use the hob/grill, and book a Gas Safe engineer). Neither asked the sensible first-step questions about hold time or smell at rest, but Conversation 2 is accurate and proportionate where Conversation 1 is alarmist and unhelpful.
